name: 靠左行動呼籲段（標誌＋標題＋說明＋並排按鈕）
desc: 滿版純色背景的單一訴求段落，所有元素靠左由上往下堆疊，右側留大片空白。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。所有元素靠左、對齊頁面內容寬度，由上往下堆疊，只佔區塊左側約三分之一寬，右側留大片空白：最上方可放一個小型標誌，沒有時省略；下方是大標題（可多行），完整落在頁面內容寬度內；大標題下方可放說明文字，沒有時省略；最下方是一顆主要按鈕，旁邊可並排第二顆按鈕，沒有時省略，其他元素的位置不變。
mobile: 結構不變，等比縮放：元素仍靠左由上往下堆疊，說明文字寬度延伸到接近內容全寬，兩顆按鈕仍並排在同一列；大標題完整落在畫面內，不超出畫面邊緣。

en.name: Left-aligned call-to-action section (logo + headline + description + side-by-side buttons)
en.desc: A single-message section on a full-bleed solid background, with all elements stacked top to bottom on the left and a large empty area on the right.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. All elements are aligned left within the page content width and stacked top to bottom, occupying only about the left third of the section, with a large empty area on the right: optionally place a small logo at the top, omitting it when there is no content; below it is a headline (may wrap to multiple lines) that stays fully within the page content width; optionally place a description below the headline, omitting it when there is no content; at the bottom is a primary button, optionally with a second button side by side, omitted when there is no content, without changing the position of the other elements.
en.mobile: The structure stays the same and scales proportionally: elements remain aligned left and stacked top to bottom, the description extends to nearly the full content width, and the two buttons stay side by side on one row; the headline stays fully within the viewport and does not overflow its edges.
